raw_response:
The issuer exhibits significant credit risk due to weak liquidity (current ratio of 0.94 < 1), high leverage (debt-to-equity ratio of approximately 1.39), and low profitability (EBIT to total assets ratio of approximately 0.54%). The implied interest coverage is extremely low, estimated below 0.3x based on reasonable assumptions for interest-bearing debt, indicating an inability to cover interest expenses from operating earnings. These factors place the rating firmly in speculative grade, specifically in the B- category due to the substantial risk, despite the substantial retained earnings providing some financial flexibility.

DECISION: B-
